main_text.l: עָבַר Ch.& Syr. Facere, conficere, efficere, operari,
Colere terrā, agere, peragere, parare, appara-
re. Pehil Syr. ܥܒܕ Affectus, ܥܒܕ Male
afficitur, affectus, Matt.17.15. Plur. ܥܒܕܝܢ?
ܥܒܕܝܢ Qui pessimè affecti sunt, Matth.4.4. Ithp. mutare transire, in vel
subire, transmutare: Mutari, transfigurari, Ex Aphel Præter. fœm. Syr. ܐܬܥܒܪ Fieri. Ex
Aphel Præter. fœm. Syr. ܐܥܒܕ Fecit, 2.ad Cor.7.11.
ܥܒܕܐ Syr. Factor, Conditor. Plural. cum Affix.
ܥܒܕܘܗܝ Factores ejus, ad Rom.2.13.
עוֹבְדָא Ch. ܥܒܕܐ Syr.Opus,factum: Item Operis
merces,Psal.109.20. Plur. עוֹבְדֵי, Syr.
ܥܒܕܝ. Fœmin. עוֹבְדְתָּא Gen.33.14.
עֲבִידְתָּא Ch.Idem. Constr. עֲבִידַת.
מַעְבַּד Ch.Idem. Plur. מַעְבָּדִין. Syr. ܡܥܒܕܐ
Opus erat ei, Oportebat eum, Johan.4.4.
ܥܒܕܐ Syr. Factor, effector, operator. Fœmin.
ܥܒܕܬܐ Effectrix, operatrix, ad Rom.4.15.
ܥܒܕܘܬܐ Syr. Operatio, efficacia, efficacitas. Ch. מַעְבְּרוּתָא
דִסִימְתָא Opus thesaurorum, Prov.21.6.
עַבְרָא עַבְדָא Ch.& Syr.Servus. Plur. עַבְרִיָא, עַבְדִין.
עַבְרוּתָא Ch.& Syr. Servitus.
עֲבוּדָא Ch. Famulitium, Genef.26.14.
עַבְדָּא Ch. Clitellæ, Genef.31.14.
